actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_current_account.description: Get the authenticated PromptHub account associated with the API token, including its current team context.
actions.get_project_head.description: Get the production-ready version of a PromptHub project (typically the last commit on master/main branch). Useful for integrating prompts into your application.
actions.get_project_head.props.branch.de: Use the head of a specific branch. Defaults to your project's master/main branch. Must be URL-encoded if the branch name contains spaces or special characters.
When enabled, any placeholders not provided in variables will fall back to your Project/Team defaults. Your variable overrides always take precedence.
actions.get_project_head.props.projectId: The ID of the project. Can be found in your browser's URL bar when viewing that project.
actions.get_project_head.props.variables: Key-value pairs to override placeholders in the prompt. Both keys and values will be URL-encoded automatically.
actions.list_projects.description: List PromptHub projects for a team. Returns information about each project's head revision and groups.
actions.list_projects.props.group.descri: Filter projects from a specific group. Must be URL-encoded if the group name contains spaces.
actions.list_projects.props.model.descri: Filter projects where the head uses a specific model (e.g., gpt-4, claude-2, etc.).
actions.list_projects.props.provider.des: Filter projects where the head uses a specific model provider.
actions.list_projects.props.teamId.descr: The ID of the team. Can be found in your browser's URL bar when viewing Team Settings, or use current_team_id from /me endpoint.
actions.run_prompt.description: Run a PromptHub project with optional variables, branch/hash, and chat payload
actions.run_prompt.props.branch.descript: The branch name to run from (defaults to main/master).
actions.run_prompt.props.hash.descriptio: Specific commit hash to run from.
actions.run_prompt.props.metadata.descri: Additional metadata to include with the run.
actions.run_prompt.props.projectId.descr: The ID of the project to run.
actions.run_prompt.props.prompt.descript: Override prompt text for the project.
actions.run_prompt.props.variables.descr: Key-value pairs to pass as variables to the prompt.
description: Integrate with PromptHub projects, retrieve heads, and run prompts.
